{
  "name": "compose",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "type": "module",
  "description": "🧩 Design-Information-Modeling for Kit-of-Parts 🏘️",
  "workspaces": [
    "elements/ui",
    "compose/assets/logo",
    "compose/assets/icons",
    "compose/assets",
    "compose/py",
    "compose/engine",
    "compose/js",
    "compose/react",
    "compose/sites/docs",
    "compose/sites/play",
    "compose/desktop",
    "compose/algorithms",
    "repo/vscode",
    "compose/net/Compose",
    "compose/gh/Compose.Grasshopper",
    "compose/go",
    "repo/client",
    "repo/server",
    "compose/rs",
    "compose/sqlite",
    "repo/sqlite",
    "coda/assistant",
    "coda/desktop",
    "compose/assets/images",
    "compose/sketchpad",
    "compose/store",
    "compose/vscode",
    "compose/3dm/Compose.Rhino",
    "compose/3dm/ui",
    "compose/ui"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.13.1"
  },
  "packageManager": "npm@11.7.0",
  "scripts": {
    "install:native": "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .devcontainer/install-native.ps1",
    "git:setup": "node -e \"const cp=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const root=process.cwd();const source='AGENTS.md';const aliases=['CLAUDE.md','GEMINI.md'];const run=(cmd,args)=>cp.execFileSync(cmd,args,{stdio:'inherit'});run('git',['config','--local','core.symlinks','true']);const repoClientCandidates=[path.join(root,'repo','client','client.exe'),path.join(root,'repo','client','client')];const repoClientPath=repoClientCandidates.find(candidate=>fs.existsSync(candidate));const repoClient=repoClientPath?{cmd:repoClientPath,args:['configure']}:{cmd:'go',args:['run','./repo/mcp','configure']};run(repoClient.cmd,repoClient.args);for(const alias of aliases){const aliasPath=path.join(root,alias);if(fs.existsSync(aliasPath))fs.rmSync(aliasPath,{force:true});try{fs.symlinkSync(source,aliasPath,'file');}catch(error){if(process.platform!=='win32')throw error;fs.linkSync(path.join(root,source),aliasPath);}}\"",
    "pre-commit:install": "pre-commit install",
    "pre-commit": "pre-commit run --all-files",
    "premcp:inspector": "npm --workspace @compose/engine run build:mcp-app",
    "mcp:inspector": "node -e \"const h=process.env.DEVCONTAINER==='true'?'0.0.0.0':'127.0.0.1';require('child_process').spawn('npx',['-y','@mcpjam/inspector@latest','uv','--directory',require('path').resolve('compose/engine'),'run','main.py','--mcp-stdio'],{stdio:'inherit',env:Object.assign({},process.env,{HOST:h}),shell:true}).on('exit',c=>process.exit(c||0))\"",
    "mcp:inspector:repo": "node -e \"const h=process.env.DEVCONTAINER==='true'?'0.0.0.0':'127.0.0.1';require('child_process').spawn('npx',['-y','@modelcontextprotocol/inspector','--config','.cursor/mcp.json','--server','repo'],{stdio:'inherit',env:Object.assign({},process.env,{HOST:h}),shell:true}).on('exit',c=>process.exit(c||0))\"",
    "dev:elements:ui:storybook": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @elements/ui",
    "dev:js:sketchpad": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev:sketchpad @compose/js",
    "dev:3dm:ui": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @compose/3dm-ui",
    "dev:sites:play": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @compose/play",
    "dev:sites:docs": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @compose/docs",
    "dev:desktop": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @compose/desktop",
    "dev:ui": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @compose/ui",
    "dev:algorithms": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @compose/algorithms",
    "dev:sketchpad": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @compose/sketchpad",
    "dev:coda-desktop": "cross-env WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npx nx dev @coda/desktop",
    "build:engine": "npx nx build @compose/engine",
    "build:sites": "cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 npx nx run-many -t build -p @compose/docs @compose/play",
    "build:desktop": "npx nx build @compose/desktop",
    "build:3dm": "cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 npx nx run-many -t build -p @compose/rhino @compose/3dm-ui",
    "build:assets": "npm --workspace @compose/assets run build",
    "build:repo-cli": "npm run build:repo-client",
    "build:repo-client": "npx nx build @repo/client",
    "build:repo-server": "npx nx build @repo/server",
    "build:repo-vscode": "npx nx build repo",
    "build:coda-desktop": "npx nx build @coda/desktop",
    "publish:docs": "npx nx publish @compose/docs",
    "publish:play": "npx nx publish @compose/play",
    "publish:sketchpad": "npx nx publish @compose/sketchpad",
    "publish:desktop": "npx nx publish @compose/desktop",
    "publish:coda-desktop": "npx nx publish @coda/desktop",
    "postinstall": "node -e \"const cp=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const pkgPath=path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','lightningcss','package.json');if(!fs.existsSync(pkgPath))process.exit(0);const version=require(pkgPath).version;const report=process.report?.getReport?.();const libc=process.platform==='linux'?(report?.header?.glibcVersionRuntime?'gnu':'musl'):'';const key=[process.platform,process.arch,libc].filter(Boolean).join('/');const pkgByKey={'win32/x64':'lightningcss-win32-x64-msvc','win32/arm64':'lightningcss-win32-arm64-msvc','darwin/x64':'lightningcss-darwin-x64','darwin/arm64':'lightningcss-darwin-arm64','linux/x64/gnu':'lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu','linux/x64/musl':'lightningcss-linux-x64-musl','linux/arm64/gnu':'lightningcss-linux-arm64-gnu','linux/arm64/musl':'lightningcss-linux-arm64-musl'};const platformPkg=pkgByKey[key];if(!platformPkg)process.exit(0);if(fs.existsSync(path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules',platformPkg)))process.exit(0);if(process.platform==='win32'){cp.execFileSync(process.env.ComSpec||'C:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\cmd.exe',['/d','/s','/c','npm install --no-save '+platformPkg+'@'+version],{stdio:'inherit'});}else{cp.execFileSync('npm',['install','--no-save',platformPkg+'@'+version],{stdio:'inherit'});}\"",
    "depcruise:layers": "npx -y dependency-cruiser@16 compose/js compose/react compose/sketchpad --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "^10.0.1",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps": "^1.3.2",

[package]
name = "compose"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]
path = "lib.rs"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1.0.228", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.149"
thiserror = "2.0.18"
uuid = { version = "1.20.0", features = ["v7", "serde"] }
nalgebra = { version = "0.34.1", features = ["serde-serialize"] }
sha2 = "0.10"
blake3 = "1.5"
hex = "0.4"
async-broadcast = "0.7"
futures-lite = "2"
async-channel = "2"
async-executor = "1.13"
async-lock = "3"
# GraphQL control plane: shared by wasm (WASM) and rlib (native tests / future hosts).
async-graphql = { version = "7.0.17", default-features = false }
async-stream = "0.3.6"
futures-channel = "0.3.31"
futures-util = { version = "0.3.31", default-features = false, features = ["async-await", "std"] }

[target.'cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")'.dev-dependencies]
wasm-bindgen-test = "0.3"

[target.'cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")'.dependencies]
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.106"
wasm-bindgen-futures = "0.4"
js-sys = "0.3.83"
web-sys = { version = "0.3.83", features = ["console"] }
serde-wasm-bindgen = "0.6.5"
getrandom = { version = "0.3.4", features = ["wasm_js"] }
uuid = { version = "1.19.0", features = ["js"] }

{

{

type Alternative {
  id: Id!
  hash: String!
  owner: Graph
  name: String!
  start: Checkpoint!
  checkpoints: [Checkpoint!]!
  store: Kit!
  draft: Draft
  transaction: Transaction
}

type Attribute {
  id: Id!
  key: String!
  value: String!
  definition: String
}

type Author {
  id: Id!
  name: String!
  email: String!
  role: String
  rank: Int
}

type Benchmark {
  id: Id!
  name: String!
  min: Float
  max: Float
  minExcluded: Boolean
  maxExcluded: Boolean
}

"""
🧩 Blueprint union (Type | Design) — what a Piece references and what a Piece's owner is.
"""
union Blueprint = Type | Design

type Change {
  id: Id!
  hash: String!
  owner: ChangeOwner!
  forwards: [OperationKind!]!
  backwards: [OperationKind!]!
}

union ChangeOwner = Transaction | Draft | Checkpoint

type ChangedDescription implements Operation {
  id: Id!
  hash: String!
  owner: Change!
  input: ChangedDescriptionInput!
  diff: Diff!
  entity: Kit!
}

type ChangedDescriptionInput {
  description: String!
}

type Checkpoint {
  id: Id!
  hash: String!
  timestamp: Timestamp
  authors: [Author!]!
  root: Kit
  parentCheckpoint: Checkpoint
  message: String
  isRelease: Boolean!
  changeCount: Int!
}

"""
✅ Lightweight signal that a command was accepted (used by `commandSucceeded`).
"""
type Command {
  requestId: Id!
  kind: String!
}

type Concept {
  id: Id!
  name: String!
  description: String
  order: Int
}

type Conflict {
  id: Id!
  backboneTip: String
  reason: String!
  createdAt: Timestamp!
}

type Connection {
  id: Id!
  hash: String!
  owner: Design!
  connected: Side!
  connecting: Side!
  gap: Float
  shift: Float
  rise: Float
  rotation: Float
  turn: Float
  tilt: Float
  u: Float
  v: Float
  description: String
  attributes: [Attribute!]!
}

type Connector {
  id: Id!
  hash: String!
  owner: Type!
  code: String!
  description: String
  portId: Id
  qualities: [Quality!]!
  attributes: [Attribute!]!
}

type Coordinate {
  u: Float!
  v: Float!
}

input CoordinateInput {
  u: Float!
  v: Float!
}

type CreatedFixedPiece implements Operation {
  id: Id!
  hash: String!
  owner: Change!
  input: CreatedFixedPieceInput!
  diff: Diff!
  piece: Piece!
}

type CreatedFixedPieceInput {
  designId: Id!
  blueprintId: Id!
  position: Position!
